card.name: Inside gene and enzyme identifiers
card.fires_on: Partway through names of genes, enzymes and viral proteins, such as the ase of peptidase-4, the A of NS3/4A, DT in NUDT15, or the number after exon. Also the opening bracket or space before amino acid or codon numbers.

modes.label: Enzyme and protein names
modes.description: Final or middle piece of an enzyme or viral protein name followed by a number or letter code.

modes.label: Exon and codon numbers
modes.description: Bracket, space or digit leading into exon, codon or amino acid position numbers.

modes.label: Gene name pieces
modes.description: Middle piece of a gene abbreviation such as NUDT15.

card.writes: It leans toward words about isolating and encoding, which fits genetic or sequence terms.
card.plain: It fires inside gene, enzyme and viral protein names and on the numbers that mark mutation positions.
